entry_title: Crystal Structure of spinach chloroplast F1-ATPase complexed with tentoxin
natural_product_context: The primary binding paper describes tentoxin as a natural Alternaria cyclic tetrapeptide. Original isolation/occurrence and manufacturing origin are not independently adjudicated here.
source_locator: RCSB 1KMH; primary paper Results: Tentoxin-Binding Site at alpha/beta Interface; methods and Table1
limits: 3.4 A reported resolution; deposited experimental-data availability flag N; no deposited structure-factor re-refinement performed. Alpha/beta entity sequences are deposited constructs; other purified-complex subunits are not claimed modeled. Paper binding-site residues are author interpretations rather than new contact calculations. No Kd/Ki or universal plant selectivity inferred.

entry_title: Maize Transketolase in complex with TPP and hydrolyzed (+)-Cornexistin
natural_product_context: Primary paper introduction cites original1991 isolation of cornexistin from Paecilomyces variotii SANK21086. Original isolation source has not been independently reviewed in this pilot; the bound diacid is not automatically a separate naturally isolated compound.
source_locator: RCSB8CI0 UP0 inhibitor entity4; primary paper co-crystal structure and mode-of-action discussion
relationship_locator: Primary paper section2.1 and Figures2/3: hydrolyzed diacid form; RCSB entry title and UP0 component definition
limits: Bound UP0 is hydrolyzed C16H22O7 rather than parent C16H20O6. Connectivity is checked by anhydride opening without erasing the two exact InChIKeys; geometry/stereochemical relation still needs source review. 8EL is a thiamine-related cofactor and is not the inhibitor. Protein source Zea mays differs from E.coli expression host. Crop-protein structure does not establish weed-target efficacy or organism safety; affinity fields remain unknown.
